_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: Exterior door with an intact perimeter seal and dry lower weather-protected opening
figures.caption: Inspect the stop, threshold, sweep, hinges, and latch before replacing weatherstrip. A door that is out of square will compress one side and leave a gap on the other no matter how new the seal looks.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: White exterior door with an even sweep contact on a clean aluminum threshold
figures.caption: Measure each side, cut the seal cleanly, and adjust it for even compression without making the latch difficult to engage. The sweep and threshold need to work with the jamb seal as one perimeter.

figures.alt: White exterior French doors with even reveals at a shaded Florida porch
figures.caption: Check daylight, drafts, and water at the full perimeter after installation. Good weatherstripping helps cooling performance but cannot replace a damaged threshold, shifted frame, or failed door alignment.
